CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
March 14, 2023 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR WORLD DOWN SYNDROME DAY – It is recommended the City Council proclaim March 21, 2023 as World Down Syndrome Day in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Mary Farfan.
5.1 Proclamation for World Down Syndrome Day
5.2
PROCLAMATION FOR GIRL SCOUT WEEK – It is recommended the City Council proclaim March 12-18, 2023 as Girl Scout Week in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Jennifer Cantrell, Troop Leader of Girl Scout Troops 15424 and 70714.
5.2 Proclamation for Girl Scout Week
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of February 28, 2023.
7.1 Minutes of 2-28-23 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated March 14, 2023 in the total amount of $1,572,115.31.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
SINGLE AUDIT REPORT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Single Audit Report for Fiscal Year 2021-22.
7.3 Single Audit Report
7.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING JANUARY 2023 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending January 2023.
7.4 Investment Report
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2022-08, SPLASH! WATERSLIDE RESURFACING PROJECT – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2022-08, Splash! Waterslide Resurfacing Project, to Safe Slide Restoration in the amount of $293,351; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total construction cost.
7.5 CIP No. 2022-08
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
ORDINANCE NO. 729 APPROVING DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT NO. 18 AND RESOLUTION NO. 23-05 APPROVING A SITE PLAN REVIEW TO INSTALL AN ELECTRONIC BILLBOARD ON VACANT PROPERTY LOCATED AT 14447 FIRESTONE BOULEVARD, WITHIN THE FREEWAY COMMERCIAL (C-F) ZONING DISTRICT - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; affirm the CEQA Exemption; adopt Resolution No. 23-05 approving a Site Plan Review for an electronic billboard at 14447 Firestone Boulevard; and Introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 729 approving Development Agreement No. 18 and a Site Plan Review allowing the installation of an electronic billboard on at 14447 Firestone Boulevard, within the Freeway Commercial (C-F) Zoning District, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.1 Public Hearing Report
8.1 Building Plans
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 23-06 AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER OR HIS DESIGNEE TO SIGN ALL DOCUMENTS AND AGREEMENTS FOR FEDERAL FUNDED PROJECTS ON BEHALF OF THE CITY OF LA MIRADA - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 23-06 authorizing the City Manager or his designee to sign all documents and agreements for federal funded projects on behalf of the City of La Mirada.
9.1 Reso. No. 23-06
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 23-07 AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO SIGN ALL DOCUMENTS AND AGREEMENTS WITH THE CALIFORNIA HIGH-SPEED RAIL AUTHORITY ON BEHALF OF THE CITY OF LA MIRADA – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 23-07 authorizing the City Manager to sign all documents and agreements with the California High-Speed Rail Authority on behalf of the City of La Mirada.
YOUTH IN GOVERNMENT
